maria: MORNING ASYNC — quick shift snapshot (SLOs / alerts / oncall follow-ups)

maria: What I did yesterday:
- Fixed Prometheus alert label for rate-limit on /v1/generate (was mapping to old route).
- Rolled gatekeeper config forward to reduce noisy 504s in prod-canary.
- Opened PR #483 to add 60s debounce for 504 alert + test.

jordan: ok good. did the PR include the runbook link?

maria: runbook updated and linked in PR: https://redwood/internal/runbooks/alerts/504-debounce — added playbook steps for paging and quick rollback.

kai: Observed 2 short p95 spikes overnight correlated to KV cache thrash on pool-a. I increased ttl on pool-a from 20s -> 120s in canary and started warmup job.

devon: can you paste the flux query you used to find the thrash? want to reproduce locally.

kai: sure — snippet I ran:```
sum(rate(redis_latency_ms_bucket[5m])) by (instance)
|> top(5)
```

maria: Blockers:
- Still seeing intermittent 502s from model-runtime when batcher queue > 3k. Can't reproduce in staging. Need help capturing a full trace with logs+kv state. @jordan can you take a look at gatekeeper telemetry + traces?

jordan: on it. can you give me a sample invocation id from the last spike?

maria: sample trace: https://tracing.redwood/trace/0x7f3c9a2b - invocation id 0x7f3c9a2b. Also notes in PR.

ops-bot: @eng-sre Deploy succeeded: canary -> 3 nodes (deploy-2026-03-16T04:11Z) :rocket:

maria: FYI rolling canary has debounce=60s enabled for 504s. will monitor dashboards for decrease in noise.

kai: Today: finish KV warmup rollout across pool-a, add histogram instrumentation for batcher queue length, and run synthetic load to stress queue.

devon: I'll review PR #483 and the runbook updates today. If I don't respond by EOD, ping me here.

jordan: I'll open a short ticket to add a synthetic traffic check that keeps p95 < 500ms for generation routes. tagging @product-observability for threshold signoff.

maria: follow-ups for oncall:
- If you see >3 consecutive 504s, follow runbook step 2 (disable canary and revert gatekeeper).
- If batcher queue > 3k, enable temporary rate limiting rule:```
POST /admin/rate_limit {
  "route": "/v1/generate",
  "limit": 50
}
```

maria: pairing offer — if anyone can help reproduce the batcher overload in a paired session today, DM me. :thumbsup:

jordan: note: I'll start with traces and gatekeeper telemetry, then hop into pairing if needed.

kai: leaving a small note in the sprint board under "reliability" with the KV changes and warmup rollout steps.

maria: thanks all — I'll post another short update after 2h of monitoring or sooner if something pops.
